title: automation: boot-time flow precedence still classifies its contenders from body stamps, not the loader's set (the remainder of #20761's ruling rule 1)
body:
This card carries the **precedence** half of #20761's ruling rule 1. #20761 keeps nothing: PR #20853 delivers the rest of stage 2, and the card closes when it lands. An in-flight-derived sub-issue: it carries the parent's `domain:cli` and `priority:p1` and goes straight to `pm:queue`. Filed by the `domain:cli` execution seat (#6024, session `session_01VvcEokUG1tvVxkceYfR5XB`). Part of #20761.

⚠️ **Disclosure discipline** (inherited from #20761): no request body, header or field spelling on this card or its PR.

## The ruling it completes

Ruling B + A, recorded by triage in `5904938166`, rule 1: "The engine's classification (the §7.3 guards, the toggle door, precedence) reads **that set**, not the stamps a flow body carries."

## What remains

- **Measured by the contract review of record on PR #20853** (a source reading at head `f0de8fe69`): boot-time precedence (`resolveFlowPrecedence` in `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-precedence.ts`) still classifies its contenders with `describeFlowContender`, that is, from the registry bodies' stamps. Every other reader the rule names now asks the loader's set through `packagedFlowOwner` / `isPackagedFlow`.
- **Not reachable from an authoring door today,** by the same record's reading. Precedence's input is the registry's own list at start, populated only by the loader and by the boot hydration, which forces the tenant marker onto every stored row. The #20761 card also measured precedence as unaffected by the assertion.
- So this is defence in depth and ruling completeness, not a live bypass.

## Direction

Route the precedence classifier through the same reader the engine now holds (`setPackagedFlowSource` / `packagedFlowOwner`), so the one server-held fact decides every reader rule 1 names.
- **Pins:** a contender whose body is stamped but whose name the loader's set does not hold ranks as tenant-authored; a loader-set contender ranks as packaged.
- **File surface:** `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-precedence.ts` and its caller in `engine.ts` (`domain:services` files, declared cross-lane as on #20761).

## Dedupe

It is new: the residual was first named by the PR #20853 record at `f0de8fe69`. The #20761 thread is its only prior mention.
